item.description:
New

  • Choose Custom under Display in Settings to show any combination of Dynamic Island, Side Rail, and Menu Bar at the same time.
  • Right-click the Dynamic Island to open Display settings directly.
  • Compare quota cycles in Usage History, with each weekly Claude or Codex cycle showing its percentage increase next to the tokens used.
  • Show Codex sessions as waiting when Codex asks for your input, and send a read-only reminder to your paired iPhone.
  • Copy diagnostics from a failed remote connection status in iPhone pairing settings to share when reporting connection problems.

Improved

  • Open the attention inbox from the expanded Side Rail, matching the menu bar panel.
  • Show OpenAI usage card refresh times and date ranges in your local time zone, with UTC billing days available on hover.
  • Show OpenAI costs with an explicit currency, such as US$0.48, and present empty or failed usage and cost states in the same compact layout.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
